notes.title: New Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

First off, big thanks to all of you who've followed and added Eureka to your wishlist. It means a lot to see people getting excited about my game!

Unfortunately, things are taking just a little longer than expected, so I had to push the release date back one week. That should give me enough time to finish what I want to finish before release. Hopefully it will be worth the wait.

So the new release date is Friday, October 21st. I look forward to hearing what you guys think. See you all next week!
